title: Vanilight GUI
description: Vanilla with sharper edges and lighter widgets.
body:
A resource pack with minimal changes to the Vanilla GUI.

Containers have sharper edges and widgets are lighter and less textured to match the in-game container styles.

The hotbar is also darker to contrast with the light elements.

---

This resource pack includes [Edgy Vanilla GUI](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/edgy-vanilla-gui) for the sharper edges on vanilla containers.
